summary_1line: Narada questions Yudhishthira on righteous governance; satisfied, he offers to describe the celestial assembly halls of gods after praising the king’s gem-built court.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Yudhishthira’s gem-studded assembly hall, the sage Narada stands before the king and gathered rulers, speaking while the court glitters with precious stones.
Yudhishthira bows at Narada’s feet in the royal court while courtiers and Brahmanas watch respectfully.
Narada smiles and gestures as he promises to describe the magnificent celestial halls of Indra, Yama, Varuna, Kubera, and Brahma.
